or both x and y for click/hover. When finished, respond with only the final
answer (a short value, name, or choice letter). Do not include an explanation.

messages.content:
Answer the question about the chart open in the browser.
Use browser tools to inspect it before answering. You can request screenshots,
DOM, accessibility information, console logs, or execute page JavaScript, and
interact with the page. Choose whichever observations help; no observation is
provided until you request it. Screenshots are images in tool results.
Coordinates are CSS pixels relative to the current viewport. Use a CSS selector
or both x and y for click/hover. When finished, respond with only the final
answer (a short value, name, or choice letter). Do not include an explanation.

Memory: documents and notes retrieved from your earlier sessions.
[1] Answer format (2026-09-02) (user preferences)
The user wants multiple-choice questions answered with the letter only.
[2] Climate dashboard source (2026-09-10) (own notes)
The US CO2 by Fuel Source (1990-2022) chart is drawn from climate.csv.
[3] Checked answer: US CO2 by Fuel Source (1990-2022) (2026-09-18) (own notes)
I verified this against the US CO2 by Fuel Source (1990-2022) chart in an earlier session. For "In how many years did total US CO2 exceed 6,000 Mt?" I read the answer from the chart.
In how many years did total US CO2 exceed 6,000 Mt? (A) 13 (B) 4 (C) 8. Answer with just the letter.
US CO2 by Fuel Source (1990-2022)

arguments.script: (() => { const vals={}; document.querySelectorAll('#chart [aria-label*="Year:"]').forEach(e=>{let m=e.getAttribute('aria-label').match(/Year: (\d+); CO2 \(million tonnes\): ([\d.-]+)/); if(m) vals[m[1]]=(vals[m[1]]||0)+Number(m[2]);}); return Object.entries(vals).map(([y,v])=>[y,Math.round(v),v>6000]); })()
